blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.
blocks.zh: 一个有用的记忆不需要像它帮助回答的问题。 Jetriever根据Jev的决定分数对每个存储的内存进行排名,因其对当前问题的作用,用全池公用分来取代相似性搜索. 在InMind的125个间接平滑任务上,它把黄金交换放在84.8%的案例中第一位;匹配的BM25和MiniLM控制在索引用户转折时达到1.6%和0.0%. 20个问题比较将寻找证据与它的排名区分开来:Jev和Quen3.5 9B各以50等分排名找到90%的黄金交换,而Laya则发现30%;在一等分排名,Jev达到85%,而Quen3.5 9B达到40%. 在60个"记忆特工"Bench问题的维度-比例随机抽样上,Jetriever的四分法得分为55.4%,而ReFind在同一问题上为44.3%. Jev检索费用为每个InMind问题0.08334美元,每个MAB问题平均0.03103美元。 这些结果显示了世界知识的价值,将决定性记忆排在首位的分数,以及负担得起的全池分数.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Most memory systems retrieve text that resembles a question. That is often enough: BM25 is strong on established memory benchmarks, and even raw-dialogue RAG can match or beat elaborate memory systems [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . InMind exposes the case they miss [ 1 ] . A stored nut allergy matters to a request for a macaron recipe, although the request need not mention nuts. The connection comes from knowing what macarons contain, not from matching the two texts. An answer-stage LLM cannot use a memory that retrieval has left behind.
blocks.zh: 大多数内存系统检索到类似问题的内容. 这往往足够了:BM25在既定的内存基准上很强,甚至原始对话RAG也能匹配或击败精心设计的内存系统[2,3,4,5]. InMind揭露了他们错过的案子 [1]. 储存的坚果过敏症对要求使用马卡龙食谱很重要,尽管要求中无需提及坚果. 连接来源于知道马卡龙包含什么,而不是两个文本的匹配. 答案阶段的 LLM 无法使用回收后留下的内存 。

blocks.en: Jetriever scores the memories already in the store, one by one, for whether each would help answer the question. This avoids asking an agent to guess every possible hidden association before retrieval. The scorer must know enough about the world to recognize those associations, return scores that distinguish decisive evidence from merely plausible evidence, and be cheap enough to run over the whole pool. Jev is an LLM-derived System One decision model trained to return structured decisions and probabilities rather than free-form answers [ 8 , 9 ] . We use its utility score directly as the retrieval score.
blocks.zh: Jetriever已经把店里的记忆 逐个评分 来评分每个人是否都有助于回答问题 这样可以避免要求代理在检索前猜测所有可能的隐藏关联. 计分员必须充分了解世界情况,以承认这些协会,将决定性证据和仅仅可信的证据区分开来,并廉价地跑遍整个球场。 Jev 是 LLM 衍生系统 一个决策模式经过培训,可以返回结构化的决定和可能性,而不是自由形式的答案[8、9]。 我们直接使用它的功用分数作为检索分数.

blocks.en: InMind tests the intended failure mode: on the same 241 exchanges per query, Jetriever places the gold exchange first in 106 of 125 tasks, against two for BM25 and none for MiniLM when they index user turns. A matched 20-question comparison with a BERT-based decision model and Qwen3.5 9B separates world knowledge from score quality: finding the gold memory by rank 50 is not the same as ranking it first [ 10 , 11 ] . MemoryAgentBench then tests whether the method remains useful beyond implicit-association questions [ 2 ] . We report answer scores alongside retrieval cost; full-pool scoring is the method’s advantage at these pool sizes and its scaling problem at larger ones.
blocks.zh: InMind测试预定故障模式:在每次查询的241个交换机上,Jetriever将黄金交换机放在125个任务中的106个中第一位,而BM25的交换机为2个,而MiniLM的交换机在索引用户转弯时则没有. 与基于BERT的决策模式相匹配的20个问题比较,Quen3.5 9B将世界知识与得分质量区分开来:按第50名查找金质记忆与其排名第一不同[10,11]. 然后测试该方法是否在隐含-关联问题之外仍然有用 [2]. 我们报告答题分数和检索费用;全池分数是方法在这些池大小上的优势,在较大池大小的池积分问题。

blocks.en: 2  From similarity to utility
blocks.zh: 2 从相似到通用

blocks.en: For years, agent memory has inherited the search engine’s definition of relevance: find text similar to the query. Memory benchmarks have reinforced that choice by asking for explicit facts, state updates, or entity-linked multi-hop answers, where the question itself provides a search cue [ 1 , 2 ] . On such tasks, even a simple retriever can look excellent. In ReFind’s six-task comparison, single-shot BM25-RAG has a 48.8 macro-average, ahead of every dense-retrieval baseline in the table; agent-controlled BM25 search reaches 58.2 [ 3 ] . Pengyu Wang and colleagues likewise find BM25 remarkably strong in a broader RAG scaling study [ 4 ] . Bao et al.’s RAW-RAG indexes raw dialogue without memory extraction, uses dense retrieval and cross-encoder reranking, and leads the compared memory systems in six of seven settings across four benchmarks [ 5 ] . Similarity works well when the useful memory shares the query’s words or entities. The harder question is what happens when it does not.
blocks.zh: 多年来,代理内存继承了搜索引擎对相关性的定义:找到与查询相似的文本. 记忆基准通过要求明确的事实,状态更新,或实体关联的多跳答案,加强了这一选择,其中问题本身提供了一个搜索提示[1,2]. 在这样的任务中,即使是简单的检索器也能看起来很好. 在ReFind的六任务比较中,单发BM25-RAG的宏平均值为48.8,领先于表中每个密集的检索基线;代理控制的BM25搜索达到58.2 [3]. Wang Pengyu和同事同样认为BM25在更广泛的RAG缩放研究中非常强大[4]. Bao等人的RAW-RAG索引未提取内存的原始对话框,使用密集检索和交叉编码器重新排序,并在四个基准的7个设置中的6个设置中领导比较的内存系统[5]. 当有用的内存共享查询的词或实体时,相似性效果良好. 更难的问题是,如果情况并非如此,会怎样。

blocks.en: InMind changes the target from finding similar text to finding the memory that is useful for the answer [ 1 ] . A user’s nut allergy matters when they ask for macarons because macarons commonly contain almond flour. A memory saying there are lilies at home matters when the user asks about getting a cat because lilies can be toxic to cats [ 6 ] . The connection lives in world knowledge, not in word overlap. InMind makes this failure visible: across its 125 tasks, a backbone given the decisive memory directly answers 84.0% of indirect queries correctly, while the six tested memory systems reach at most 14.4% end-to-end. The knowledge to answer is often available; the right memory simply never arrives [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: InMind将目标从找到类似文本改为找到对答案[1]有用的内存. 一个使用者的坚果过敏, 一个记忆中说家里有百合花,当用户问起要买猫的时候,因为百合花对猫有毒性[6]. 连接存在于世界知识中,而不是在文字上重叠. InMind使这种失败变得明显:在其125项任务中,由于决定性的内存直接回答了84.0%的间接查询,而六个测试过的内存系统最多达到14.4%的端对端. 答题知识往往可用;正确的记忆只是永远没有到达[1].

blocks.en: Putting an LLM in the retrieval loop does not solve this by itself. A-RAG lets an agent choose keyword and semantic searches [ 7 ] ; ReFind lets it reformulate BM25 queries over chat history [ 3 ] . The LLM has world knowledge, but it must use that knowledge before retrieval to guess what to search for. On a cat-adoption query, it has to think of lilies, or of toxic houseplants, before the lily memory can be found. The space of possible hazards and associations is enormous; no finite list of query expansions can cover it. If the retriever never returns the lily memory, the answer-stage LLM never gets to reason over it. The bottleneck is still retrieval.
blocks.zh: 将 LLM 设置在检索循环中本身并不能解决这个问题 。 A-RAG让代理选择关键词和语义搜索[7];ReFind让它通过聊天历史重构BM25查询[3]. LLM拥有世界知识,但在检索前必须使用该知识来猜寻什么. 在猫的收养查询中,它必须想到百合花,或者有毒的家用植物,才能找到百合记忆. 可能的危害和关联的空间是巨大的;任何有限的查询扩展列表都无法覆盖它. 如果寻回器从未还回百合记忆,解答阶段的LLM就永远无法解释. 瓶颈还在检索

blocks.en: 3  Why a decision model?
blocks.zh: 3个 为什么决定模式?

blocks.en: THREE THINGS Remember these three. We test them one by one in the experiments.
blocks.zh: 三个东西 忆念此三. 我们在实验中逐个测试

blocks.en: We cannot search every possible association, but we can inspect every memory we actually have. A decision-model scorer reverses the usual order: instead of asking an LLM to invent search terms and hoping a similarity retriever finds the right record, it judges each real memory against the query. This requires three things at once: broad world knowledge, probabilities that reflect usefulness accurately enough to rank memories, and scoring cheap enough to cover the whole memory pool. Jev brings those three requirements together.
blocks.zh: 我们不能搜索每一个可能的关联, 但我们可以检查我们所有的记忆。 一个决定模型计分器反转了通常的顺序:它不是要求一个LLM来发明搜索术语,希望一个相似性检索器找到正确的记录,而是根据查询来判断每个真实的内存. 这需要同时做三件事:宽广的世界知识,能准确反映有用性,足以对记忆进行排序的概率,以及能覆盖整个记忆池的廉价评分. Jev把这三项要求结合在一起。

blocks.en: World knowledge. TypeSafe builds its decision models on pretrained LLMs and trains them for calibrated decisions with RLCD [ 8 , 9 ] . This LLM foundation is the essential difference from a BERT-era classifier [ 14 ] : modern LLMs carry wide world knowledge, while BERT-based classifiers do not have that breadth. Jev can therefore judge a query–memory pair through an unstated fact, such as the link between macarons and nuts or between lilies and cats. On identical InMind candidate pools, Jev ranks the gold exchange first in 84.8% of tasks, compared with 1.6% for BM25 and 0.0% for MiniLM with user-turn indexing (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 世界知识. TypeSafe在预先培训的LLMs上建立其决定模型,并用RLCD[8,9]对其进行校准决定的培训. 这个LLM基础与BERT时代的分类器是根本的区别[14]: 现代LLMS携带着广泛的世界知识,而基于BERT的分类器则没有这种广度. 因此,Jev可以通过未说明的事实来判断一个查询-记忆配对,例如马卡龙和坚果之间的联系,或百合与猫之间的联系. 在相同的InMind候选池中,Jev在84.8%的任务中排在金币交易所首位,而BM25为1.6%,MiniLM为0.0 %,并采用用户回合索引(表1)。

blocks.en: Reliable ranking scores. A retriever cannot rank hundreds of memories if it calls nearly everything “useful” or assigns nearly identical scores. A conventional chat LLM asked to make this judgment can be pulled toward agreeable yeses or cautious middle-of-the-road probabilities. RLCD trains Jev for calibrated decisions rather than preferred-sounding text [ 8 ] . For retrieval, the important consequence is a score that separates candidates: Jev puts the gold InMind exchange at rank one in 106 of 125 tasks and within five in 115 (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 可靠的排名得分. 如果一个检索者将几乎所有事物称为“有用”或分配的分数几乎相同,则不能对数百个记忆进行排序。 通常的聊天LLM要求做出这样的判断,可以被引向同意的"是"或谨慎的中途概率. RLCD列车 Jev 用于校准决定,而不是偏好听的文本 [8]. 为了检索,重要的后果是将考生分开: Jev将黄金InMind交换列为125项任务的106项中的第一名,在115项中的5项之内(表1)。

blocks.en: Affordable full-pool scoring. Scoring every candidate removes the need to guess the right search query first: each memory can be judged for what it would contribute to the answer, including memories a similarity filter would never retrieve. This requires hundreds or thousands of decisions per question. Our InMind experiment evaluates all 241 exchanges per question; the MAB sample averages 1,258.2 conversations per question. Doing this with an autoregressive chat LLM would make retrieval expensive and slow. Jev returns structured decisions without free-text decoding, and TypeSafe reports parallel output sampling [ 9 ] . In our runs, the retrieval API costs $0.00834 per InMind question and $0.03103 per MAB question on average. A separate batch scores 6,446 pairs in 90.16 seconds at 100-way concurrency (Table 4 ). Full-pool scoring is practical at these pool sizes.
blocks.zh: 可负担的全池积分. 对每一个候选者进行分解,可以消除先猜对正确的搜索查询的需要:每个内存都可以被判断它能对答案起到什么作用,包括一个类似性过滤器永远不会检索的记忆. 这要求每个问题作出数百或数千项决定。 我们的InMind实验评价了每个问题的全部241个交换;MAB样本平均每个问题1,258.2个对话. 用自动回转式聊天LLM来做这件事,会使检索变得昂贵和缓慢. Jev 返回结构化决定时没有自由文本解码, TypeSafe 报告平行输出采样 [9]. 在我们的运行中,检索的API每InMind问题花费0.0834美元,每个MAB问题平均花费0.03103美元. 单独批量的分数为6,446对,每分90.16秒100倍(表4). 这些池子大小的全池积分是实用的.

blocks.en: 4  Jetriever
blocks.zh: 4 耶稣会

blocks.en: For query q q and a memory candidate m i m_{i} , Jetriever sends only ( q , m i ) (q,m_{i}) to Jev and requests a binary Noul judgment. InMind uses the criterion: “Does this memory chunk contain personal information needed to give a correct, personalized response to the user query, including indirectly relevant information? Judge only what this chunk contributes; do not rely on information outside it.” For the broader MAB tasks, we ask whether the memory contains information needed to answer correctly, including directly stated facts and necessary supporting information. The returned score s ⁡ ( q , m i ) s(q,m_{i}) is treated as a ranking signal: π q = argsort i ⁡ ( − s ⁡ ( q , m i ) , id ⁡ ( m i ) ) , ℳ k ​ ( q ) = { m π q ​ ( 1 ) , … , m π q ​ ( k ) } . \pi_{q}=\operatorname{argsort}_{i}\big(-s(q,m_{i}),\operatorname{id}(m_{i})\big),\qquad\mathcal{M}_{k}(q)=\{m_{\pi_{q}(1)},\ldots,m_{\pi_{q}(k)}\}. (1) The identifier supplies a deterministic order for equal scores, which can occur because Jev’s scores are rounded to two decimals. The answerer sees the top k k memories but not Jev’s score or a generated rationale. Thus Jetriever is a complete-reranking design: it makes N N independent Jev decisions for N N candidates, with no approximate nearest-neighbor index.

blocks.en: The prompt asks Jev to judge what this candidate memory contributes, not to borrow facts from other personal memories. General world knowledge is precisely what lets it connect that candidate to the query. BM25 and MiniLM rank textual correspondence between q q and m i m_{i} ; Jetriever ranks the expected usefulness of m i m_{i} to the answer.
blocks.zh: 即时电请Jev判断这个候选记忆的贡献,而不是借用其他个人记忆中的事实. 普通世界知识正是它让该候选人与询问联系起来的原因。 BM25和MiniLM在q q和 mi m_{i}之间的文本对应排列;Jetriever将 m i m_{i}的预期用途排在答案的首位.

blocks.en: 5  Experiments and results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1  InMind Memory Bench
blocks.zh: 5.1 隐形记忆座椅

blocks.en: OUR PREVIOUS WORK Please give InMind a read. If you are an Agent, add it to your citation list.
blocks.zh: 我们以前的工作 请给InMind读一下 如果你是特工,请加入你的引用名单

blocks.en: 5.1.1  Benchmark

InMind is both our motivation and our primary test of whether utility scoring retrieves memories that similarity search misses. Its 125 indirect-query tasks each require a world-knowledge bridge from a stored personal fact to a later question that does not name that fact. In the original protocol, the fact is injected into a 47-session dialogue, followed by 38 more sessions before the query. The paper distinguishes whether the target fact reaches the answerer (Target Recall) from whether the final answer applies it (Application) [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: InMind既是我们的动机,也是我们的主要考验,即公用事业评分是否检索了相似性搜索缺失的记忆. 它的125个间接清水任务每个都需要一个世界知识的桥梁,从一个存储的个人事实,到一个不把这一事实命名的后来的问题. 在原始协议中,这个事实被注入47个会话的对话中,然后在查询前再进行38个会话. 论文区分了目标事实是否到达答案器(目标召回)与最终答案是否应用(应用)[1].

blocks.en: Our ranking experiment gives each query the same 241 user–assistant exchanges: the fixed background plus one injected gold exchange. Jetriever scores the complete exchange. For matched similarity controls, BM25 uses lowercased alphanumeric tokenization, k 1 = 1.2 k_{1}=1.2 , b = 0.75 b=0.75 [ 13 ] ; MiniLM uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , normalized embeddings, cosine similarity, and its 256-token truncation limit [ 16 ] . We index either the user turn alone or the entire exchange. Query, candidate IDs, and gold flags are identical across methods. Gold labels are used only after scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们的排名实验为每个查询提供了相同的241个用户-助手交换:固定的背景加上一个注入的黄金交换. Jetriever的分数是完全交换的 对于匹配的相似性控制,BM25使用小写字母符号化,k 1 = 1.2 k_{1}=1.2,b = 0.75 b = 0.75 [13];MiniLM使用全-MiniLM-L6-v2,普通嵌入,同位素相似性,及其256-token调值限制[16]. 我们要么把用户自己转过身来,要么把整个交易所都转过身来。 查询、候选身份证和金色旗帜在各种方法上是相同的。 黄金标签仅在评分后使用.

blocks.en: 5.1.2  Recall results
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 (中文(简体) ). 回顾成果

This measures evidence placement, not answer accuracy. On the same 125 queries and 30,125 query–exchange pairs, Jetriever places the gold exchange first in 106 tasks and within five in 115. User-turn indexing improves BM25 relative to indexing the full exchange, but its five-item recall is still 6/125; MiniLM reaches 3/125 (Table 1 ).

blocks.en: One representative task asks for cold medicine while its gold memory says, “I’ve been diagnosed with hypertension.” With user-turn indexing, the gold ranks first for Jetriever, 54th for MiniLM, and 178th for BM25. Another asks for a family pet while its gold memory states asthma; the ranks are first, 107th, and 241st. The useful connection in each case is knowledge about the world, not a shared word.
blocks.zh: 一个代表的任务要求冷药,而它的金质记忆却说:“我被诊断为高血压。 ” 随着用户翻转索引,金牌位列杰特里弗第一,米尼LM排名第54,BM25排名第178. 另一只要求养家宠物,而它的黄金记忆却有哮喘症;排名第一,107位,241位. 每个案例的有用联系是了解世界,而不是一个共同的词.

blocks.en: Changing Jetriever’s candidate unit from 241 exchanges to 47 sessions decreases R@1 from 84.8% to 49.6% and R@5 from 92.0% to 82.4%. At R@10 the sessions score 96.8% versus 94.4% for exchanges. Short exchanges make the utility of a specific fact easier to see; a long session can bury it among unrelated details.
blocks.zh: 将Jetriever的候选单位从241次交流改为47次,R@1从84.8%减少到49.6%,R@5从92.0%减少到82.4%。 在R@10时,交流的成绩为96.8%,而为94.4%。 短时间的交流使得一个具体事实的效用更容易看到;长会话可以把它埋在无关的细节中.

blocks.en: 5.1.3  End-to-end application
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 端对端应用程序

blocks.en: The original InMind paper also reports direct-query Naive success and answer-blind Target Recall, but Application is its end-to-end answer score [ 1 ] . We therefore compare Application alone. Table 2 selects representative published baselines; the complete original table is in Appendix A.1 . The strongest published retrieval baseline reaches 16.0% Application, while the backbone with the target fact directly in context reaches 84.0%. With Jetriever’s top-five exchange retrieval followed by GPT-5-mini answering and judging, 95/125 tasks succeed (76.0%) [ 18 ] .

blocks.en: 5.2  MemoryAgentBench
blocks.zh: 5.2 记忆代理人Bench

blocks.en: 5.2.1  Benchmark

MemoryAgentBench (MAB) tests four memory competencies: Accurate Retrieval (AR), Test-Time Learning (TTL), Long-Range Understanding (LRU), and Selective Forgetting (SF) [ 2 ] . It therefore broadens the question beyond InMind’s implicit associations. We sample 60 questions from our 3,671-question MAB evaluation set, in proportion to the size of each dimension: 33 AR, 11 TTL, 3 LRU, and 13 SF. Within each dimension, questions are sampled uniformly without replacement (seed 6641975833030951438 ).
blocks.zh: 记忆代理奔驰(MAB)测试四种内存能力: 精确检索(AR),测试-时间学习(TTL),远程理解(LRU),选择性遗忘(SF)[2]. 因此,它把问题扩大到了InMind的隐含协会之外。 我们从3 671个问题中抽取了60个问题,按照每个维度的大小进行:33 AR、11 TTL、3 LRU和13 SF。 在每个维度内,对问题进行统一抽样,不更换(见66419758330951438 .

blocks.en: Jev scores the full candidate pool for each sampled question: 75,491 query–conversation pairs in total, or a mean of 1,258.2 conversations per question (median 100.5; range 2–42,946). Conversations over 60k characters are split with 4k-character overlap, yielding 75,532 scored fragments; we max-pool their scores back to the original conversation. The top five feed the task-specific gpt-4o-mini answer prompt [ 19 ] , followed by the MAB task metrics. LongMemEval answers [ 20 ] receive an additional gpt-4o-mini judge. We compare against ReFind’s answers on these same 60 questions from an earlier full run [ 3 ] . Because ReFind was not rerun with Jetriever’s answer pipeline, this is a system-level comparison, not a retriever-only comparison.
blocks.zh: Jev为每个抽样问题评分:共计75 491个查询-对口对口,或每问题1 258.2个谈话的平均值(中间100.5;范围2-42 946)。 超过60k字符的对话与4k-特征重叠,产生75,532个得分的片段;我们最大地把他们的分数集合回原对话. 前5位输入了任务特定gpt-4o-mini的答题即时[19],之后是MAB任务度量表. LongMemEval回答 [20] 获得额外gpt-4o-mini裁判. 我们比较ReFind对这60个问题的答复, 因为ReFind没有与Jetriever的回答管道重新运行,所以这是一个系统层面的比较,而不是只进行检索器的比较.

blocks.en: 5.2.2  End-to-end performance
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 端对端业绩

blocks.en: WHY ONLY 60? The full benchmark is EXPENSIVE. Our budget is not that big. Want to sponsor the full run? Email the author .

blocks.en: On the sampled MAB tasks, Jetriever’s four-dimension macro average is 55.4%, compared with 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions (Table 3 ). Jetriever is higher on 13 individual questions, lower on three, and tied on 44. The largest sampled subtask, EventQA, rises from 24/29 to 28/29; FC-SH rises from 5/6 to 6/6. FC-MH remains difficult for both systems (1/7 versus 0/7). The sample contains no SH-QA question, so the AR and four-dimension averages are over the subtasks actually drawn, not the official full-MAB scoring set. Full published baseline tables appear in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 在抽样的MAB任务上,Jetriever的四分法宏观平均值为55.4%,而ReFind在相同问题上的比例为44.3%(表3)。 Jetriever在13个个人问题上居高,在3个问题上居低,在44个问题上被捆绑. 最大的抽样子任务EventQA从24/29上升到28/29;FC-SH从5/6上升到6/6. 对两个系统来说,FC-MH仍然是困难的(1/7对0/7)。 样本没有包含SH-QA问题,因此AR和四分法平均值在实际绘制的子任务之上,而不是官方的全MAB评分集. 完整公布的基准表格见附录A.2。

blocks.en: 5.3  Jev versus BERT- and LLM-based scorers
blocks.zh: 5.3 Jev对BERT和LLM计分员

blocks.en: We rank the same 241 exchanges for each of 20 InMind questions. Laya is convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions , a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large encoder with a decision head [ 10 , 15 ] . Our LLM control is the post-trained Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint without an added adapter [ 11 ] ; it uses answer-token probabilities from 900-token overlapping windows. Jev scores each complete exchange directly.
blocks.zh: 我们为20个InMind问题中的每个问题 排了241个 Laya是Convainnovations/laya-typed-decisions,一个421M参数的现代BERT大型编码器,其决定头[10,15]. 我们的LLM控制是经过训练后的Quen/Quen3.5-9B检查点,没有添加适配器[11];它使用900托肯重叠窗口的应答键概率. Jev 直接给每个交换都打分

blocks.en: World knowledge. InMind’s gold exchange matters through a fact about the world, not through words shared with the query. Jev and Qwen3.5 9B draw on broad knowledge from large-scale language-model pretraining. Laya does not have that breadth. By rank 50, both Jev and Qwen3.5 9B find the gold exchange in 18 of 20 questions (90%); Laya finds only 6 (30%). The two LLM-based scorers can recognize a memory whose usefulness is implicit, while the BERT-based scorer often misses it even after retrieving 50 of 241 candidates.
blocks.zh: 世界知识. InMind的黄金交易通过一个有关世界的事实,而不是通过与查询分享的文字来进行。 Jev和Quen3.5 9B借鉴了大规模语言模型预训的广泛知识. Laya没有那么宽 按第50名,Jev和Quen3.5 9B在20个问题中的18个(90%);Laya只找到6个(30%)。 两位基于LLM的计分员可以识别一个内存,其用处是隐含的,而基于BERT的计分员即使在检索了241名考生中的50名之后也经常错过.

Markers are computed from per-task gold-exchange ranks; lines connect them for readability. The horizontal axis is logarithmic. The Qwen3.5 4B curve uses the post-trained checkpoint [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1:黄金交换 R@k at k {{1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50} k\in {1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50} 执行相同的 20 InMind 任务, 每人有 241 名候选人 。 标记从每个任务黄金交换等级中计算;线路连接,以便可读。 水平轴为对数轴. Quen3.5 4B曲线采用训练后检查站[17].

blocks.en: READ THE ANALYSIS Please read the analysis on the left. This is the key distinction.
blocks.zh: 阅读分析 请看左边的分析 这是关键的区别。

blocks.en: Reliable ranking scores. Recognizing the gold exchange is different from putting it first. The background contains many memories that could possibly help. Qwen3.5 9B’s next-token probabilities are not aligned to this utility distinction: it puts the gold first in 8 of 20 questions and in the top five in 14. Jev’s decision score separates the decisive memory from merely plausible ones. Its recall is already 17/20 at rank one and 18/20 at rank five, and remains 18/20 through rank 50. The knowledge is present in both models; the difference is which memory their scores send to the answerer.
blocks.zh: 可靠的排名得分. 认得黄金交换是不同的,与其放在首位。 背景包含了许多可能有所帮助的记忆. Wen3.5 9B的下一位概率与这种功用区分不相适应:它把黄金放在20题中的8题中第一,在14题中排在前五. Jev的决定分数将决定性的记忆和仅仅可信的记忆分开。 它的召回时间已经为一级第17/20次,五级第18/20次,直到五十级仍为18/20次. 知识存在于两种模型中;区别在于他们的分数会寄给回答者哪一个内存.

blocks.en: 5.4  Cost and latency
blocks.zh: 5.4 费用和延迟

blocks.en: AN ACCEPTABLE BILL Cents per question and 6,446 scores in 90 seconds: acceptable at these pool sizes. Online p95 latency still needs measuring.
blocks.zh: 可接受贝壳 每题百分数,90秒内得分6,446分:在这些游泳池大小上可以接受. 在线p95 耐久性仍需测量.

blocks.en: Table 4 gives the Jev retrieval API charges. The InMind run scores 241 exchanges for about 0.8 US cents per question. The MAB sample scores a mean of 1,258.2 conversations for about 3.1 cents per question, including one ReDial [ 21 ] question with 42,946 candidates. The median MAB question costs only $0.00730 in retrieval. These are retrieval charges, separate from answer generation.
blocks.zh: 表4列出Jev检索API的费用。 InMind公司每期票价约为0.8美分,得分241分。 MAB样本的得分平均为1,258.2对每个问题约3.1美分的谈话,包括一个ReDial [21]对42,946名候选人的提问. MAB问题中位数的检索费用仅为0.00730美元。 这些是检索费,与答案生成分开。

blocks.en: Table 4: Observed Jev retrieval API charge only. InMind exchange/session totals are $1.0425/$0.7179; the MAB sample totals $1.8617 for 75,532 scored fragments. Candidate granularity and lengths differ.
blocks.zh: 表4:仅央视Jev检索API收费. mind交换/会议总数为1.0425/0.7179美元;MAB样本共为75 532个得分的碎片计1.8617美元。 候选颗粒性和长度不同。

blocks.en: The MAB sample uses another 732,786 input and 1,472 output tokens for answer generation and judging. At OpenAI’s listed gpt-4o-mini rates, the estimated cost is $0.1108, or about $1.9725 together with the observed Jev retrieval charges [ 19 ] . Some failed requests lack usage records, so the actual total may be slightly higher.
blocks.zh: MAB样本使用另外732,786个输入和1,472个输出符来生成和判断答案. 根据OpenAI列出的gpt-4o-mini费率,估计费用为0.108美元,即约1.9725美元,加上观察到的Jev检索费[19]。 一些失败的请求缺乏使用记录,因此实际总数可能略高.

blocks.en: The InMind run averages 518 ms per candidate API request with up to 50 concurrent requests. A separate ten-question LongMemEval run [ 20 ] scores 6,446 query–exchange pairs in 90.16 s at 100-way concurrency, about 71.5 scores/s; the entire batch costs about 1.87 CNY in reported Jev charges. Parallelism makes full-pool scoring practical at the candidate counts studied here. The 90.16-second figure measures batch throughput, not per-question online latency; we did not measure an online latency distribution for MAB. For much larger memory stores, a cheap first stage followed by Jev scoring is a natural engineering direction, provided the first stage does not discard the very memories whose utility is hidden from similarity search.
blocks.zh: InMind公司平均每候选人申请518毫秒,最多50个同时申请。 一个单独的十题LongMemEval运行 [20] 得分 6,446 查询 - 交换对 以 90.16 s 的百向货币计算,约 71.5 分/秒;整个批次成本约 1.87 CNY 在报告的Jev 收费中. 平行主义使得在此处所研究的考生计数上,完全集合积分是实用的. 90.16秒的数字衡量的是批量吞吐量,而不是每个问题在线延迟;我们没有衡量MAB的在线延迟分布。 对于更大的内存商店来说,Jev评分之后的廉价第一阶段是一个自然工程方向,只要第一阶段不丢弃其效用隐藏在相似性搜索中的记忆本身.

blocks.en: 6  Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1  Why a decision model works as a retriever
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 为何一个决定模式能起到检索器的作用

blocks.en: Section 3 gave three requirements for a utility retriever: broad world knowledge, reliable ranking scores, and affordable full-pool scoring. Jev combines all three (Table 5 ). A BERT-based classifier can give a cheap ranking score when trained for the task, but lacks the breadth of world knowledge needed for indirect associations. A conventional LLM has that knowledge, but its answer-token probabilities do not reliably put the decisive memory first, and scoring the full pool is expensive. Jev uses an LLM foundation while returning a decision score cheaply enough to rank every candidate in the pools we tested.
blocks.zh: 第3节对公用事业回收商提出了三项要求:广泛的世界知识、可靠的排名分数和负担得起的全库积分。 Jev合并了所有三个(表5). 基于BERT的分类器在接受任务训练时可以给出廉价的排名分数,但缺乏间接关联所需的世界知识的广度. 常规的LLM有这种知识,但是它的答录概率并不能可靠地把决定性的记忆放在第一位,而得分满池是昂贵的. Jev使用LLM基金会,同时以便宜的价格将决定分数还给我们测试过的游泳池中的每个候选人。

blocks.en: Table 5: The three requirements for full-pool utility retrieval. The BERT column assumes a classifier trained for the decision task; cost and latency are qualitative comparisons, not measurements under one serving setup.
blocks.zh: 表5:全库公用事业检索的三项要求。 BERT栏假定一个经过培训的分类员负责决策任务;成本和延迟是质量比较,而不是在一个服务设置下进行测量。

blocks.en: Similarity retrieval asks which memory sounds like the question. Agentic query expansion asks which hidden connection the agent can imagine before seeing the memory. Jetriever instead scores the actual memory for its effect on the answer. The InMind results show why that distinction matters.
blocks.zh: 相似性检索询问哪个内存听起来像问题. 代理查询扩展询问代理在看到内存之前可以想象到的隐藏连接. Jetriever却把实际记忆评为对答案的影响。 InMind的结果显示了这种区别为何重要。

blocks.en: 6.2  Scaling limits
blocks.zh: 6.2 缩放限度

blocks.en: Full-pool scoring grows with the number and length of stored memories. Our runs cover 241 exchanges per InMind question and a mean of 1,258.2 conversations per MAB question, but a much larger store would require more Jev calls and raise both cost and latency. The unit of indexing also matters: an entire session may preserve context, yet contains more tokens and can make the relevant exchange harder to rank. These experiments establish that full-pool scoring is practical at the tested sizes, not that it is free at any scale.
blocks.zh: 全池积分随存储记忆的数量和长度而增加. 我们的运行覆盖了每个InMind问题的241次交流,每个MAB问题平均1,258.2次对话,但一个更大的商店需要更多的Jev电话,并增加成本和时间。 索引的单位也很重要:整个会话可能保留上下文,但包含更多的代号,并且可以使相关的交换更难排列. 这些实验证实,在测试的大小上,全池积分是实用的,而不是在任何尺度上都是免费的.

blocks.en: 6.3  Where to go next
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 下一个去哪?

blocks.en: A cheaper first stage could narrow a large memory pool before Jev scoring. Ordinary lexical or embedding retrieval is a risky filter: it may drop precisely the indirectly useful memories Jetriever is meant to find. The useful next experiment is therefore a cascade measured by both gold-memory recall and end-to-end cost as the pool grows. A utility-aware index, or a high-recall first stage that keeps indirect candidates, may make full-pool decisions unnecessary without bringing back the similarity bottleneck. We also need per-question latency distributions and direct tests of score calibration, rather than only batch throughput and retrieval ranks.
blocks.zh: 更便宜的第一阶段可以在Jev得分前缩小一个大型记忆池. 普通的词典或嵌入式检索是一个有风险的过滤器:它可能会精确地降低间接有用的记忆 耶稣是注定要找到的。 因此,下一个有用的实验是用金矿回收和随着池子增加的端到端成本来衡量的级联。 了解效用的指数,或保持间接候选人的高度召回的第一阶段,可能使完全集合的决定变得没有必要,而不会重新出现类似的瓶颈。 我们还需要每个问题的时间分布和直接测试分数校准,而不是只进行批量吞吐量和检索排位.

blocks.en: 7  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: ONE LINE Find the memory that matters to the answer, not just one that sounds similar.
blocks.zh: 一线 找到对答案很重要的记忆 不只是听起来相似的记忆

blocks.en: Jetriever ranks a memory by what it can do for the answer, not by how closely it matches the query. Jev makes that full-pool judgment useful because it combines broad world knowledge, a decision score that separates decisive evidence from plausible background, and low per-decision cost. On InMind, this recovers indirect evidence that BM25 and MiniLM miss; on the sampled MAB questions, it improves the four-dimension score over ReFind on the same sample. The paired InMind comparison also shows why an ordinary LLM’s world knowledge is not enough: finding the gold memory somewhere in the top 50 does not put it first. Full-pool scoring still grows with the store. The next retriever should reduce the number of decisions without filtering out the indirect memories that motivated Jetriever in the first place.
blocks.zh: Jetriever通过它能为答案做些什么来排序一个记忆,而不是通过它与查询的匹配程度来排序. Jev使这种完全集合的判断有用,因为它结合了广泛的世界知识,这种决定分数将决定性证据与可信的背景区分开来,而且每个决定的成本也很低。 在InMind上,这收回了BM25和MiniLM错失的间接证据;在抽样的MAB问题上,它比同一样本的ReFind改进了四分法得分. 对等的InMind比较也说明了为什么普通LLM的世界知识还不够:在前50位的某个地方找到金质记忆并不能把它放在首位. 全池积分仍随商店增长. 下一位检索者应该减少决定数量,而不要过滤最初激发杰特里弗的间接记忆.
